title: Moscow holds 80th anniversary Victory Day parade attended by Xi Jinping
body:
On 9 May 2025, Russia held its Victory Day parade on Red Square in Moscow, marking the 80th anniversary of the Soviet Union's victory over Nazi Germany. Chinese President Xi Jinping was Russian President Vladimir Putin's guest of honour and sat beside him in the viewing stand. Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva also attended, and North Korean military officials were present. China sent a contingent to take part in the event.

Troops from every branch of the Russian military marched, together with soldiers from former Soviet republics, and a large array of weaponry was displayed. Central Moscow was closed for several days beforehand. CBS News described the parade as a show of nuclear strength, and noted that planning had taken months.

In his speech Putin acknowledged that Russia was going through a "difficult, watershed moment in its history" and gave few specifics about what he calls his "special military operation" in Ukraine.

Ukrainian attack drones forced airports around Moscow to close during the week of the parade. CBS News reported that tens of thousands of Russian soldiers had been killed over the previous three years of fighting. The parade took place a week before the direct Russia-Ukraine talks in Istanbul on 16 May.
